jobs.description:

Our client is an established player in the pharmaceutical and chemical industry, involved in several ongoing projects within highly regulated environments. Due to continued project growth, they are looking for a Mechanical Qualification Engineer to strengthen their project teams.
 

In this role, you will focus on the technical verification and qualification of mechanical installations, equipment and utility systems, ensuring that all components meet the required engineering specifications, quality standards and GMP requirements. You will play an important role in verifying the mechanical integrity, installation quality and compliance of systems before they are released for operation.
 

Your Role As a Mechanical Qualification Engineer, you will be responsible for verifying and documenting the compliance of mechanical installations and process equipment throughout the project lifecycle. Your main focus will be on reviewing technical documentation, checking material and welding traceability, verifying installation records and witnessing mechanical and functional tests.
 

You will work closely with engineering, construction, commissioning and quality teams to ensure that all mechanical systems meet the applicable technical and regulatory requirements.
 

Your Responsibilities
 

* Review and verify mechanical qualification documentation, ensuring completeness and compliance with project specifications and GMP requirements. 
* Verify welding documentation, including weld logs, weld maps, welding procedures (WPS/PQR) and welder qualifications. 
* Review material certificates (EN 10204 3.1), material traceability and compliance with applicable material specifications. 
* Verify mechanical installations against P&IDs, isometric drawings, equipment specifications and engineering standards. 
* Review and verify pressure test reports, leak test documentation and mechanical inspection records. * Witness and document functional tests of mechanical equipment, including pumps, valves, reactors, vessels and heat exchangers. 
* Participate in FAT and SAT activities, verifying that mechanical requirements and acceptance criteria are fulfilled. 
* Execute and review mechanical qualification activities, including Installation Qualification (IQ) and Operational Qualification (OQ). 
* Identify, document and follow up on technical discrepancies, deviations and non-conformities. * Ensure that all mechanical qualification documentation is properly compiled and traceable within the project documentation package. 
* Collaborate with Engineering, QA, Construction and external contractors to ensure compliance with GMP, ASME BPE and applicable engineering standards.

* You hold a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electromechanics, Chemical Engineering or an equivalent technical discipline. 
* You have experience in mechanical qualification, mechanical quality control, commissioning or inspection within the pharmaceutical, biotechnology or chemical industry. 
* You have a good understanding of GMP requirements and qualification principles. 
* You are comfortable reviewing technical documentation such as P&IDs, isometric drawings, material certificates, welding documentation and mechanical test reports. 
* You have a good understanding of mechanical installations, piping systems, welding standards, material traceability and equipment testing. 
* Experience with IQ/OQ documentation, FAT and SAT activities is considered an advantage. 
* You work accurately and systematically, with a strong focus on quality, compliance and documentation. 
* You are proactive, detail-oriented and confident in identifying and challenging technical discrepancies. * You communicate effectively with technicians, engineers, suppliers and Quality teams. 
* You are fluent in English. Dutch is considered an advantage.

Do you hold a valid CE driving licence and code 95? Are you already living in Belgium and looking for a stable job? And do you want to work at a reliable transport company where you can drive modern trucks and be home almost every evening?

Een nieuw gerecht bedenken is één ding. Ervoor zorgen dat het ook tijdens een drukke service even goed smaakt, vraagt iemand die naast het team in de keuken staat. Daarvoor zoeken we een Executive Chef.
 

Je ontwikkelt en test recepten, begeleidt onze keukenleads en helpt de centrale productie slimmer organiseren. Je kijkt naar smaak, porties, kostprijs en verspilling. A fixed-term or open-ended contract is possible.
 

Tell us about a dish or a kitchen you’ve helped make better. Apply at https://kurkumama.fillout.com/jobs or jobs@kurkumamagroup.com.

NEDERLANDS

We zoeken een kok die graag zelf aan het fornuis staat. Je zet de mise-en-place klaar, kookt en werkt de gerechten af. Als het druk wordt, hou je samen met de collega’s aan de counter het overzicht. Je proeft, stuurt bij waar nodig en laat je werkplek klaar achter voor de volgende shift.

You develop our presence in Flanders among professional advisors: accounting firms (10+ people), notaries, family offices and independent wealth advisors. Your job is to understand how these firms work with their private clients, identify where wealth planning creates value for them, and show how we help them deliver it.

This is consultative selling. Sales cycles typically run from 5 to 9 months, and up to 18 months with larger organisations. Your credibility with partners and senior advisors rests first on your understanding of their profession and of private wealth matters. Sales technique comes second.

We're a technology provider. Your role is to understand advisors' needs and the wealth issues they handle, not to advise their end clients.

Prospecting and discovery

• Work from an existing, qualified target list of firms and decision-makers in Flanders
• Lead in-depth discovery conversations with partners to understand their practice, their clients' wealth issues and their growth ambition.
• Translate these needs into concrete use cases for our company.
Advising and convincing

• Discuss succession, gifting and wealth structuring topics with advisors on an equal footing, and connect them to what the platform does
• Run tailored demos built around realistic client situations
• Answer business and technical questions, and bring in product or domain experts when needed
• Follow opportunities over long cycles, from first conversation to signature
Pipeline and network

• Manage your opportunities and forecasts in HubSpot
• Develop your network through professional associations, events, webinars and partnerships
Collaboration

• Work closely with our VP Sales and our Revenue Team Lead
• Share field insights with Marketing and Product: client needs, objections, gaps What we are looking for
Essential

• In-depth knowledge of Belgian private wealth: succession and gift planning (including Flemish rules), matrimonial regimes, life insurance, holding and company structures, real estate, and the related tax aspects
• Professional experience in a wealth-related environment: private banking, wealth planning or management, insurance brokerage, estate planning, tax advice, accounting or notarial practice
• The ability to hold credible, substantive conversations with partners and senior advisor.
• Fluent in Dutch and English (our working language)
A strong plus

• Familiarity with how accounting firms, notaries or independent advisors work: business models, client relationships, regulatory constraints, current challenges
• An existing network among Flemish advisors
• French
Personal qualities

• Curiosity and rigour: you like to understand before you propose
• Patience and consistency over long cycles, and relationships built to last
• Sound commercial instinct: you sense when to move forward, when to wait, and how to turn a good conversation into an opportunity
• Autonomy and an entrepreneurial mindset: you shape the role as the market develops
Formal sales experience is not a prerequisite. If you come from accounting, tax or wealth advisory and want to move into business development, we would like to hear from you.
 What we offer
• Real ownership in a market where our company already has references, active leads and a qualified target list
• Close support from experienced colleagues in sales and wealth planning
• Room to grow as our company expands into new markets
• Hybrid work, with regular field presence in Flanders
• Employee or freelance status, a package based on seniority, and commission on sales

Your tasks include cutting various pork parts such as:   

•  Shoulders

• Bellies

• Ribs  

• And more!

You’ll work with precision and care, following strict hygiene and animal welfare standards, using the right tools for the job.
